claims.claim_text: Support for major federal infrastructure investments to reverse U.S. middle-class decline and employ millions of Americans in decent-paying public- and private-sector jobs.
The climate emergency and the need to expand the U.S. middle class require the most ambitious infrastructure investment since President Eisenhower created the interstate highway system.
Commitment to employ Americans updating and expanding roads, bridges, public transit, airports, and passenger and freight rail lines.
Commitment to build modern U.S. energy and water systems, modernize schools and continue supporting high-speed broadband expansion.
Commitment to invest in green, resilient infrastructure to protect communities against climate impacts and help mitigate those impacts.
Commitment to address deferred-maintenance backlogs in the four principal U.S. public-land management agencies.
Commitment to modernize drinking-water and wastewater systems to protect public health and safety.
The federal infrastructure investments proposed in 2016 will create secure, well-paid middle-class jobs in the near term.
The federal infrastructure investments proposed in 2016 will substantially increase demand for U.S.-made steel and other domestically manufactured products.
The federal infrastructure investments proposed in 2016 will create many more jobs in subsequent years by promoting fair, equitable economic growth and stronger long-term U.S. competitiveness.
